items.title: Buy, Sell, or Hold? Monday’s Top Upgrades and Downgrades: Advanced Micro Devices, Airbnb, DraftKings, L3 Harris Technologies, Molson-Coors, Nvidia,  Take-Two Interactive, Uber Technologies, and More
items.summary: Nvidia just lost a vote of confidence while AMD earned a $600 target, and Wall Street's chip debate is splitting wide open. Add a Fed rate hike looming and a flurry of fresh Citigroup calls, and Monday's analyst moves get interesting.

items.title: CRAI Q3 Earnings & Revenues Surpass Estimates, Stock Barely Moves
items.summary: Charles River Associates beats Q3 earnings and revenue estimates, raises its 2026 revenue outlook and hikes its dividend, yet shares remain largely unchanged.

items.title: 3 Stocks Built on Recurring Revenue That Could Keep Growing for Decades
items.summary: You probably can't name the company that services your office elevator, treats your baseboards, or hauls your dumpster. That anonymity hides businesses customers rarely leave, yet two of these three stocks stumbled this year. What went wrong?

items.title: ICFI Q3 Earnings Beat Estimates on Margin Gains, Revenues Miss
items.summary: ICF International's Q3 2026 earnings top estimates despite a revenue miss, as stronger margins and contract awards boost profitability and backlog.

items.title: WEX Q3 Earnings & Revenues Beat Estimates, Stock Declines 3.5%
items.summary: WEX tops Q3 earnings & revenue estimates, driven by Mobility growth & higher fuel prices. It raises its 2026 outlook despite a post-earnings stock decline.

items.title: TRI Q3 Earnings & Revenues Miss Estimates, Stock Declines 9.9%
items.summary: Thomson Reuters' Q3 earnings & revenues miss estimates despite double-digit growth, as rising AI adoption is offset by margin pressure and weak cash flow.
